source_text: הָיָ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤/י כְּ/אוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כָּל אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔י/הָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑י/ו וַ/יֶּ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/בַת יְהוּדָ֔ה תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַ/אֲנִיָּֽה׀־־׃ס
english_snapshot: The Lord became like an enemy; he swallowed up Israel. He swallowed up all her palaces; he destroyed his strongholds[a], and he multiplied mourning and lamentation in Daughter Judah.

signals.text: Hebrew 'his strongholds'; some translations smooth this to 'her strongholds' to match 'her palaces,' but the Masoretic Text reads a masculine singular suffix.

source_text: חַֽסְדֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ כִּ֣י לֹא תָ֔מְנוּ כִּ֥י לֹא כָל֖וּ רַחֲמָֽי/ו־־׃
english_snapshot: Because of Yahweh’s steadfast love we are not consumed[a], for his mercies never come to an end.

signals.text: Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient versions support the alternative, ‘Yahweh’s steadfast love never ceases.’ That reading treats steadfast love as the subject and reads the first verb differently.
